name: sampled
description: Sampled traffic, as the recipe serves it: closed loops at sixteen, eight and one stream over the default prompts at temperature 1 and top-p 1 (DeepSeek's 1017 defaults, the recipe's override-generation-config) with a fixed per-request seed, thinking off, 60 s warm-up and 300 s measured each. The other suites decode greedily, so draft acceptance under sampling (and anything that changes it, such as probabilistic drafting) is measured only here.
